snippet.title: Drop Duchy | The North DLC | AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description:
DLC + free update available now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525310/Drop_Duchy/

This new faction introduces a brutal new playstyle:
- Targeted attacks : strike enemies with precision
- Pillaging : raid resource buildings for extra loot
- Fury : gain bonus troops based on damage taken

Alongside this DLC comes Patch 1.2, free for all players:
- 3 brand-new bosses, each with unique mechanics
- Ascension Mode – climb through 10 tiers with custom modifiers
- 12 new cards + new challenges, quality-of-life upgrades, and more!
